item.text: {"claim_id":"C061","obligation_id":"C061-B-1","contract":"GOVERNANCE_STRUCTURE","subject":"Departures from the specified trial must be documented before outcomes are interpreted.","verdict":"SATISFIED","unresolved_conditions":[],"rationale":"The rule has a sufficiently determinate trigger—departures from the specified trial—and a clear prescribed response: document those departures before interpreting outcomes.
